items.title: How to automate your Microsoft Windows Server upgrades using AWS Systems Manager – Update
items.summary: Introduction Keeping Microsoft Windows Server current is an ongoing challenge, and two end-of-support (EOS) milestones make it especially pressing. Windows Server 2012 and 2012 R2 reached end of support on October 10, 2023, and Windows Server 2016 extended support ends on January 12, 2027. After these dates, Microsoft no longer provides security updates or patches, […]
